# 2 Baruch Chapter 87 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**87:1** And it came to pass, when the eagle had been sent out and had flown away, that I, Baruch, went to the oak tree of Mamre, beneath which Abraham, our father, once prayed to the Lord when he was visited by his angels; and I, Baruch, remained there.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering arbitrated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Where translators diverged, SOPHIA selected the rendering best balancing accuracy, readability, and theological fidelity.*
